remarks:
62 Acres of deer hunting and recreation in Busti.
Pure deer hunting! Looking for a place to deer hunt or camp, perhaps build a cabin or park a camper? This  property offers the perfect combination of seclusion and accessibility, located on the Pennsylvania border between Busti and Clymer, it s accessed via a gas well easement road, ensuring privacy and a maintained convenient entry.
Abundant deer sign throughout the property makes this a prime location for hunters or outdoor enthusiasts. The property borders several large tracts of undeveloped land on all sides, creating an expansive and uninterrupted hardwoods habitat for local wildlife, especially whitetail deer.  A large food plot is established with a high house and low house hunting bling on it, as well as other multiple stand site throughout the property. Whether you’re seeking a quiet place to set up a hunting stand, build a camp, or just escape into nature without ever leaving the city limits, this is the rare opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Timber rights convey, Hardwoods, Deer Hunting, Turkey hunting , Electric at the road, Food plots, Hunting blinds, 5.2 miles to Busti, 12.4 miles to Clymer, NY, 2.2 miles to Sugar Grove, PA
